results.previousDetail: Re-derived from raw DTSX. CONFIRMED parts: (1) Mechanism: Script Component, account.Id = Row.accountid; account["name"] = Row.name only when Extensions.CheckIfToUpdate(ref Row,"name","namedb","string") is true; queued and sent via CRM.Proxy ExecuteMultipleExtension(RequestType.Update) in batches of 100, with the remainder sent at EndOfRowset. Supported. CRM.Proxy is an external assembly that was not supplied, so the SDK behaviour comes from its types (IOrganizationService/Entity/ExecuteMultipleResponseItem), not from its code. (2) VALUE fields: Last_Name_9 (file pos 35-74), First_Name_10 (75-94), Employer_Name_39 (313-362). Positions were recomputed from the FlatFileColumn widths. Insert To MY_FileData copies them straight to staging. 'Read MY Data From Staging' selects them under the same names. 'Trim String Fields' Trim()s each one and turns an empty string into NULL. Then 'Create Additional Columns' sets name (wstr 61) = !ISNULL(Last_Name_9) && Last_Name_9 != "" ? TRIM(Last_Name_9) + (!ISNULL(First_Name_10) && TRIM(First_Name_10) != "" ? " " + TRIM(First_Name_10) : "") : First_Name_10. Then 'merge customer id number and corporate number' replaces name with Employer_Name_39 when TRIM(name) == "" || ISNULL(name). If (DT_I8)accountnumber is 0, 1 or 18, 'Set unknwon customer data' replaces name with the literal "לקוח לא ידוע", and in this flow accountnumber itself is not changed. Union All maps name from both inputs to its output. No later component touches name: the only consumers of the Union All name lineage are Create Account, Union All 2 and Update Account. (3) INFLUENCE: Customer_Id_Number_6 (pos 16-24) and Employer_Number_38 (pos 304-312) become accountnumber. Customer_Id_Number_6 is trimmed, padded to 9 with zeros, and replaced by Employer_Number_38 when it is 0. accountnumber picks the unknown-customer branch, is the Lookup 'Check if account exists' key (CRM conn, account WHERE statecode = 0, joined to accountnumber_db) that returns accountid (the record key) and name_db, and name_db is the compare value ('Set null to empty String fileds': name_db == "" ? NULL : name_db). The comparison is String.Equals: case-sensitive, both NULL = equal, one NULL = different. MISSING: what happens when the file-side name is NULL. That case occurs when Last_Name_9, First_Name_10 and Employer_Name_39 are all blank (NULL after the Trim script) and accountnumber is not 0, 1 or 18. If CRM name is not NULL, CheckIfToUpdate returns true and the code runs account["name"] = Row.name. The generated getter is `return Buffer.GetString(BufferColumnIndexes[10]);` with no IsNull guard. SSIS PipelineBuffer.GetString on a NULL column throws ColumnIsNullException. That is SSIS runtime behaviour, not something the DTSX itself shows. The exception is caught by catch (Exception e) → Row.ErrorText, DirectRowToCastingError. The entity is never added to myEntities, so NULL is never written to name, and the whole row's update is dropped (all compared attributes and gen_modifiedbybank) and goes to the CastingError → ETL Warning path. The claim's 'Row.name as is' plus 'one NULL = different' suggests a NULL would be sent. It should say that a non-NULL name is written only when it differs from CRM, and that a NULL file name aborts the row's update. Everything else in the claim is correct.

results.detail: Re-derived from raw DTSX. Mechanism: an OLE DB Command on connection CRM (Data Source=psql; Initial Catalog=ALTSHULER_MSCRM; no package configuration overrides it inside the DTSX) runs 'UPDATE AccountBase Set gen_inputsource = 1, gen_isoperate = 1, name = ?, ...'. That is direct SQL DML on a CRM base table, so Unsupported. name is the 1st '?'. The '?'s were counted in the SQL in order: name, gen_address1_buildingid, gen_address1_city, gen_returnedmailcount, Gen_customerdateofbirth, ModifiedBy, gen_postalcode, accountId, postalcode, line1, ParentId (11 in total). Param_0 is bound by externalMetadataColumnId to input 'name' (lineage Union All 6 name, wstr 61 → Param_0 wstr 160, so no truncation). There is no change detection: the command runs for every Lookup-matched row, so a NULL name overwrites CRM. VALUE fields: Last_Name_9 and First_Name_10, read as lastname and firstname (externalMetadataColumnId ExternalColumns[Last_Name_9]/[First_Name_10]). 'Trim String Fields' Trim()s them and turns an empty string into NULL. 'Set columns' then sets name = !ISNULL(lastname) && lastname != "" ? TRIM(lastname) + (!ISNULL(firstname) && TRIM(firstname) != "" ? " " + TRIM(firstname) : "") : firstname. If (DT_I8)accountnumber is 0, 1 or 18, 'Set unknwon customer data' sets name to "לקוח לא ידוע" and accountnumber to "000000000". Union All 6 maps name from both inputs. Employer_Name_39 is correctly NOT a source here. No other component in the flow references the name lineage: Add 0, remove duplicates, Format Dates 1, Add Additional Fields and Convert To Date do not have it as an input. INFLUENCE: Customer_Id_Number_6 → accountnumber (trimmed, padded to 9 with zeros). It picks the unknown-customer branch, and it is the key of Lookup 'Check if account exists' (SELECT ... FROM account with no statecode filter, JoinToReferenceColumn accountnumber), which returns accountid = Param_7 (WHERE accountId = ?). For unknown customers the key is "000000000". Write-level filters (last row, customer type, Row_Level_147, dedupe) belong to the writer, not this attribute. No other writer of account.name exists apart from the two Create Account and two Update Account components. Context, not a defect: the precedence chain runs 'Create Account For Employers' before 'Create Accounts For Minhali' in each loop iteration, so if both flows hit the same account, this unconditional SQL value is the last one written.
